projects.title: TwinMind
projects.subtitle: Live transcription + suggestion agent
projects.summary: Three-pane meeting copilot: browser captures ~30s audio chunks, FastAPI proxies Groq Whisper with NDJSON streaming transcription, then returns exactly three typed suggestion cards plus grounded chat expand/continue. Prompt contracts enforce JSON schema; JSON-mode retry handles provider incompatibilities. Frontend Next.js 16 + TypeScript; backend FastAPI + httpx. Groq models: whisper-large-v3 and a configurable chat/reasoning model.

projects.title: Personal Chatbot-RAG
projects.subtitle: Portfolio knowledge assistant with FAISS retrieval
projects.summary: Personal portfolio Q&A chatbot deployed for the public site. Knowledge is chunked offline into a FAISS index; at runtime the service embeds the user query via Hugging Face Inference API, retrieves top chunks, and generates answers with Groq. Designed for free-tier hosting by keeping PyTorch off the deploy image.

projects.title: DocReporter
